registryEntry.label: Microsoft Service Health and Security Advisory Evidence
evidence_commands: $r = @((Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/admin/serviceAnnouncement/messages?$top=25&$orderby=lastModifiedDateTime desc&$filter=severity eq ''high''').value | Where-Object { $_ }); [pscustomobject]@{ count = $r.Count; advisories = @($r | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ id = $_.id; title = $_.title; severity = $_.severity; startDateTime = $_.startDateTime; lastModifiedDateTime = $_.lastModifiedDateTime; category = $_.category } }) } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5

metadata.commandExecuted: [manual/evidence-only] Microsoft Service Health and Security Advisory Evidence
